t:
That was amazing! I knew a band like this will be popular, but I had no idea how much!

What does it prove? That all races can work together and live in peace!
r171101.n: That was amazing! I knew a band like this will be popular, but I had…

t: Did we win you over with our concert? I knew it! Admit it, it's marvelous when different voices sing in unison! My House... did a lot of harm in its time. Perhaps I can atone... Perhaps...
r171104.n: I give my vote to the House de Vevre!

t: House de Delice deserved to win, we have to admit that. As you can imagine, my vision of Sarnaut's future is concurrent with hers.
r171105.n: House de Delice deserved to win, we have to admit that. As you can…

t: My brother and I must sign this? Why would we? Excuse me, but you have yet to prove yourself by serving the magic and our House.
r171109.n: My brother and I must sign this? Why would we? Excuse me, but you have…

t: Now you understand that they used to fascinate the elves. It led many to ruin, and some to madness. There's great power in dragon blood. We all use it. Are we worthy of it? This question has yet to be answered.  Here's the signature.
r171110.n: Irene Vipers were the dragons that turned the elven mages into the Great Mages.

t: Well, I can sign it. Your deeds speak for themselves. You have proved that the future of magic is safe with you. I have my brother's permission to sign it on his behalf. Dragons are the base of the Great Mages' power. This world wouldn't survive without them. Do you even realize that everything started here, on Irene?
r171111.n: Well, I can sign it. Your deeds speak for themselves. You have proved…

t:
I'm glad to see you on the side of House de Delice!

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Delice. In return, your reputation with us will grow.
r171121.n: I want to accept House de Delice Patronage

t:
Oh, this is wonderful.

House de Delice is famous for its portal magic. We invented stationary portals to travel between allods. But now our House is staking on diplomacy. Our effort resulted in an agreement with vampires, which will be signed during the Great Ball. This isn't the only thing we could achieve. We're ready to resolve any conflicts and assist during negotiations with the Empire - and stop the war forever.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House. The widest range of underwear.

Our House servants are powerful werebears. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Lyr de Delice will join you. He's famous for his romantic victories and can win any heart!

And here's your cherry on top: we recently purchased a cheap batch of Matter of Creation, required to build a Guild allod. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r171122.n: I want to know more about House de Delice patronage

t:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House. The widest range of underwear.

Our House servants are powerful werebears. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Lyr de Delice will join you. He's famous for his romantic victories and can win any heart!

And here's your cherry on top: we recently purchased a cheap batch of Matter of Creation, required to build a Guild allod. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r171123.n: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Delice?

t: I'm glad you can appreciate their beauty. You've come a long way. I'll sign your permit.
r171125.n: Dragons are truly beautiful. I understand why the first elves were fascinated by them...

t: Beauty is a great power. Do we have the right to judge the world by our own values? Did we become someone else when we abandoned Beauty in favor of Pleasure? I often think about it. Look at the Irene Viper through the eyes of the first elves. What do you see?
r171126.n: Beauty is a great power. Do we have the right to judge the world by…

t: Darling, I'd sign your papers with great pleasure if only you have earned our House's trust. I'm sorry, but it won't happen until you've earned it.
r171127.n: Darling, I'd sign your papers with great pleasure if only you have…

t:
As for Catherina and these Children... I'm wary of giving you advice.

We need to find a solution that would satisfy both parties.

But remember this - you and I are residents of Sarnaut and must act in our own interests first and foremost.

Finding a compromise on our terms is your task.

You bring some very interesting news...

Well, I assumed there were many interesting things outside of our world...

And now, our task - of the Elves and the House de Delice, is to become ambassadors to these many worlds... I think we'll find a reasonable approach.
r171129.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t: I'm happy to see you, ! Welcome to the Great House de Delice! I'm Antoinette de Delice, the head of the House and the Great Mage of the Ignis allod.
r171130.n: I'm happy to see you, ! Welcome to the Great House de Delice! I'm…

t:
Ugh, the knife-eared and their scheming! I hate the way they drag you into their intrigues.

Well, a low profile it is, then. I'm not good at it, though, so you'll do the talking. In the meantime, I'll scan their brains and find out what they're truly thinking. Afterwards, I'll wipe this conversation from their memories. So you'll be in the clear.

How do you like the idea?
r171134.n: We should keep a low profile.

t: Women are nothing but trouble. Let's just ask her directly.
r171135.n: I need to figure out Antoinette's problem with her daughter, Iris.

t:
Hello there! Here you are, . Want see a local specialty? Huh! They say de Delice have something that no one has ever seen here before.

Hey, what's with the face? The king and his missions again, eh? What are they after, huh? Go on, spit it out.
r171136.n: Hello there! Here you are, . Want see a local specialty? Huh! They say…

t: The girls always have some maids around. Sweet servants who always know who goes where and with whom.
r171180.n: Who can tell me where to find her?

t: Oh, right! Iris. I haven't been following her. She's got a lot of weird ideas. You know, after what happened on Igsh.
r171181.n: We hear Antoinette is looking for someone.

t: Glory to the arch-duchess, the eternally beautiful, wise, and generous patroness!
r171182.n: Glory to the arch-duchess, the eternally beautiful, wise, and generous…

t: No. I know for sure that none of the sisters saw Iris before she disappeared.
Iris? Yes, I know a little. I'm her servant. Her and her sisters'. Iris is weird. No wonder! After everything she's been through! It could have happened to me.
r171242.n: Uh, no? Look, do you know anything about Antoinette's daughter she's looking for?

t: I'm free, no thanks to the League. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring. I'm a little grateful to the Imperials now that it's over, although I understand that their reasons were purely diplomatic.
r171243.n: How do you like Irene after the Imperial captivity?

t: Pfft, right. It's great that it's over. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring.
r171244.n: Are you grateful to the Great Yasker for setting you free?

t: Hello, heroes! Have you seen a ladybug around? I've seen one. I really like ladybugs. Some day I want to become one.
r171245.n: Hello, heroes! Have you seen a ladybug around? I've seen one. I really…

t: I know a man has courted her... You know, de Vevre, the war hero? He doesn't care much about reputation, so... perhaps, he's Zizi's best option.
r171250.n: Do you think someone knows where to find her?

t: Yep. It's Iris. Poor thing, life was harsh on her. That's why she's doing strange things now. Her reputation is ruined. Any appearance among the noble can trigger a scandal. What else is she supposed to do? I mean, other that participating in questionable affairs. Poor thing.
r171251.n: I hear your mother's looking for someone.

t: The vampires will probably stay in Amarantha unless Catherina objects. You know, we have a plan to relocate all the undead to a separate allod. I think it's named Jigran. Marianna Lopatina has recently rediscovered it. The elven part of House de Douceur is likely to reside on the Nea allod.
r171252.n: Where do they want to go?

t: You can't tell, but deep down they're nervous. You know, de Desirae could forget about it if Roxane gives up her rights on Nocturne.
r171253.n: Are vampires here, too? Aren't they afraid of revenge of the Houses de Desirae and de…

t: Oh, a familiar face. I knew we'd meet soon.
r171254.n: Oh, a familiar face. I knew we'd meet soon.

t: She loves heroes, you know – the type that can erect a flag on top of an enemy fortress. Yeah. I guess she's with one of them.
r171260.n: Do you have any idea at all where she could be and with whom?

t: Hm. Zizi is a super important person. He never tells anyone where she's going and with whom. She could at least share her boys!
r171261.n: Do you happen to know where Iris is?

t: We've been very busy since that nasty cardinal started pestering us! Aurora is on Ignis, Beata is back there on Al Rihat, and poor me is in charge. I'm the eldest. My head is spinning!

Um... Do you mean Zizi? Or Iris? I've seen her with... no, I can't tell you. Although you must know... those who fought the architects? You must have dealt with them, too, so you know enough... Oh Tensess! What am I saying? It's so embarrassing.
r171268.n: You can touch me all you like as long as you answer my question.

t:
Erm... No. Wait. Give a moment... I can't believe I've met you in person.

I'm so excited I'm going to puke!

Phew, that was close.

Whee! Is it really you? Can I touch you?
r171269.n: Hello! Yes, it's me! Do you know something about the sister your mom is looking for?

t: Yep, that's me. I mean, no! No! There's also Zoe, but she's a baby. So that makes me what, the second youngest daughter? I'm a, you know, an adult, all grown-up and responsible! That's me! Now I'm babbling. I'm sorry. It's just that... I'm your fan, and here you are, in all your glory! And I lost it. Kind of. What am I saying? I lost it! Sorry.
Oh, I can't believe it's really you! I'm seeing you with my own eyes!
r171271.n: Oh, I can't believe it's really you! I'm seeing you with my own eyes!

t: I have no idea. She disappeared quite suddenly. She left all her things behind, at home. I'm very worried about her. This allod only looks safe. Something's going to happen.
r171276.n: Do you know where I can find her?

t: That's right. Who told you? Yes, I'm courting Iris. She's a sweet girl, even though she's been through a lot.
r171277.n: I hear, you're friends with one of Antoinette's daughters?

t: Thanks for asking. Everything's in order. War changes people... We survived many things. We lost many. Some comrades remained on the battlefield. I see them in my dreams. I'm questioning myself – why did I survive when they died?
r171278.n: How are you doing after the war?

t: Hey, buddy! I didn't expect to meet you here on Irene. Do you remember... How we captured that stronghold? Those were the days.
r171279.n: Hey, buddy! I didn't expect to meet you here on Irene. Do you…

t: It's pretty creepy. I don't know what to do now. I can leave my shard, because I'm not allowed to show up in the "upper society". Well, I guess it's time for a sweet candy! No one will go looking and no one will ask for names since everything is in plain sight.
r171283.n: Read the last page of the diary

t:
My dear Iris! I was astonished to learn you're gathering information about me. No offence, honey, but I need you to send over everything you've got so far, otherwise the consequences will be very unpleasant. Neither I nor His Eminence would want that.

Sincerely yours, E.

I find all this very disturbing. I need to talk to Gala and maybe Cantor about what's happening. Hardly anyone will trust me, I'm afraid. If I'm right, we're in grave danger.

[There's a note between the last pages of the diary]
r171285.n: Open the second to last page

t: The inscription on the frontal page goes, "This is private property of Iris de Delice. No one can read it but the owner."
r171286.n: The inscription on the frontal page goes, "This is private property of…

t: We don't disclose information about our visitors. Overly intrusive and prying individuals shall be banned.
r171293.n: I hear the arch-duchesse is looking for her daughter. I wonder where she might be.

t: I can offer it to you for a certain sum of ecu. But as a special guest, you can also borrow it for me for a time.
r171318.n: Can I borrow the Mask of Ardent Love?

t: Exactly. I believe you'll like him, too. Here, take his calling card. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. Use the calling card again, and the companion will understand that it's time for them to leave. Good luck!

What a wonderful idea! You'll get an excellent companion, and we'll strengthen our authority. Which is why one of the best representatives of our House will go with you: Lier de Delice. Everyone adores him!
r171355.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: You already have Lier with you!
r171356.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: I'm afraid our House does not know you well enough.
r171357.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: Oh, we have nothing against you personally, but your patron House... It won't do.
r171358.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t: I hope they won't be upset. Here, the calling card of our handsome diplomat, Lier de Delice!
r171359.n: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

t: I've been informed you already have a companion. Do you wish to part with them?
r171360.n: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

t:
If you build a good reputation with one of the great Houses, they will be happy to allow a member of the House to travel with you as your companion on Irene. Not only will it let you spend time in pleasant company, you will also gain bonus reputation with the House your companion belongs to. Of course, no House will provide a companion for you if your patron House is their rival.

You can discuss the possibility with any quartermaster of a House.
We take our job seriously. We're diplomats.
r171362.n: We take our job seriously. We're diplomats.

t:
Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!
r171375.n: Everything is ready. I want to go to the garden.

t:
Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!

Do you like it?

You can try on a different outfit if you like.

Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit. Try on our suggestion. We wouldn't want to bore you with fittings and measurements on your first visit here.

Well, who's entering the garden of pleasures today?

Listen to your heart, it's calling out your true name!

The Rose and Hibiscus is the place where we hang out and enjoy beauty. All flowers of our garden are equally beautiful. Each is worthy of attention and respect. By entering this door, you agree to leave your former self behind. This place knows no factions, Houses, or faces. There are only masks and nicknames. True names must be respected and never revealed. And of course, there's no room for weapons and armor that hide the true beauty of Nature's creation.

Follow these simple rules, and you will enjoy true pleasure in our beautiful garden.

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures. Is this your first visit?

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, let me tell you about our house rules.
r171388.n: Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures. Is this…

t:
Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit.

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures!

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, you will need a proper name and outfit.
r171419.n: Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures! Before you…

t: Say I believed you. But first, I need a drink. Can you bring me a cocktail? I need to pull myself together.
r171429.n: I can help you get to the king.

t: What a generous offer. As if I were looking to return to the company of hypocrites, who show their bravery only while wearing masks. On the other hand... I have something to tell him. There's a conspiracy on Irene. We're all in danger.
r171430.n: He wants you back at the court.

t: Wow! What does His Majesty want with a humble person such as myself?
r171431.n: Wait! I'm here on the king's orders. He asked me to find you.

t: Ha! Money makes the world go round. I could steal something from the Bunker. I talked to the local smugglers. Of course, I had to spend a week in your underground water supply system. But then I got on board of the ship to Avilon, and finally arrived at Novograd. I wish I were a writer, I could write a book. Nice talking to you, but I need to go.
r171432.n: Did you manage to escape town?

t: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.
r171433.n: Keep it down! Don't you recognize me? Remember who helped you out with clothes in…

t: There I am! Who are you? I can't recognize you in this mask, darling. I don't do private dance, mind you.
It's you! I thought you looked familiar... but I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.
r171435.n: You don't recognize me, do you? Remember who helped you out with clothes in Nezebgrad?

t: I'm used to different clubs. This one feels like home. That's strange...
r171436.n: I'm used to different clubs. This one feels like home. That's strange...

t: I can't say no to Sweet Candy! My best cocktail for the most charming lady. On the house.
r171442.n: Ask for a cocktail for Sweet Candy

t: We're pouring happiness in glasses! What happiness are you looking for today?
r171443.n: We're pouring happiness in glasses! What happiness are you looking for…

t: Just go, don't look around. I'll take care of it.
r171469.n: Just go, don't look around. I'll take care of it.

r171471.n: Iris's gone missing. Have you seen her?

t:
Hah! Hey hop!

How is it going? Did Iris tell you something?
r171472.n: Hah! Hey hop! How is it going? Did Iris tell you something?

t: That's what I call a party! Elves aren't boring at all, hehe.
r171473.n: That's what I call a party! Elves aren't boring at all, hehe.

t: You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures.

You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures. Thing is, our visitors are hiding their identities. This allows them to feel relaxed and not fear the consequences. A pleasure is only a pleasure when you don't have to pay a price. Those wanting to enter must contribute by purchasing this mask from a hostess, who controls the gifts of our beautiful and generous arch-duchesse.

Oh traveler! You are standing before the gates that lead to eternal joy! Everyone that enters should know: your wishes are heard! You will find here what you have been looking for!

What are you looking for?
r171480.n: Oh traveler! You are standing before the gates that lead to eternal…

t:
Some rules they've got here! This place means business, I can tell.

I wonder if they'll even let me in, huh.
r171488.n: Some rules they've got here! This place means business, I can tell. I…

t: Isn't it obvious? I'm a lepidopterologist. I study butterflies. I even had a collection that I carelessly took with me on a journey. An Imperial cruiser intercepted our ship. I ended up in prison and lost my collection. I was humiliated, insulted, and mistreated! Now I'm trying to regain my mental equilibrium here on Irene.

This is outrageous! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs! Just think of it! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash!
r171492.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: On Irene? It's not that bad. I think I spotted another undiscovered butterfly. Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to.
r171493.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.
r171494.n: My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

t: Hmm. I'm a professional scout. I used to recruit agents on Igsh. I was caught, arrested, and sent to prison. Now I need to figure out what to do next. I might use the Hall of Changes: dye my hair, change my face, or even become a lovely lady for the time being, hehe. But holidays first.

I know they've been trying. They dropped off their troops on Igsh, captured the XAES... it's a shame it didn't work! But I guess there's only so many battles you can win. If the plan worked, we would have won the war. The way things went... well, there was peace and the anti-architectural alliance.
r171497.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: Wonderful! Just look at all the beautiful girls! My mind and body are relaxing after the Imperial prison.
r171498.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: I'm glad to see the League's renowned hero!
r171499.n: I'm glad to see the League's renowned hero!

t: The League tried to free us while the Empire was messing things difficult for them... and you helped them! If Yasker thinks we're too stupid to see through his deception... I feel sorry for him.
r171500.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: It's wonderful. My mind and body are relaxing after your prison. And look at all the beautiful girls!
r171501.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Hmm... did they let you in here? Unwise...
r171502.n: Hmm... did they let you in here? Unwise...

t: I'm pretty noble by blood! I'm Caspar de Vevre's second cousin once removed! Now that I'm free, I'm thinking of writing an autobiography. I'll write down everything I've been through! "Humiliated and Insulted" will be its title. It should be quite a volume.

Oooh, it was so rude of the League! They were supposed to save me! But they simply forgot about me! It was so humiliating! Me, an aristocrat, in the hands of arrogant Imperial rabble!

I remember fantasizing about being captured... tied and slowly undressed... it seemed so hot! That wasn't what happened in real life. I was freezing in prison, and the food was bad.
r171507.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: Oh, it's fun! I'm glad they invited you. I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. I'm glad to finally be here, after everything that happened.
r171508.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Hey there! I don't know you in person, but I've heard a lot. How are you?
r171509.n: Hey there! I don't know you in person, but I've heard a lot. How are…

t: Oooh, it was so rude of the League! I expected to be rescued, even imagined a knight on a shiny... dreadnought! But they simply forgot about me! But you freed me. That's something. Come over tonight. I'll thank you properly!
r171510.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. Oh, but this one is so much fun! I'm glad they invited you.
r171511.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Hey there! Your face is familiar! How are you doing?
r171512.n: Hey there! Your face is familiar! How are you doing?

t: Just like my House, I'm interested in alchemy. Combat alchemy, of course. Why else would the Empire have taken me prisoner? I study explosives, choking gas, et cetera. All this mana energy is quite interesting, but trust me, alchemy has many secrets, too. Today we use gunpowder to blow things up, but if... ugh, it's top secret, I can't tell you that.
Oh, really. You know what? Stick your apologies where the sun doesn't shine. You didn't try hard enough.
r171518.n: I want to apologize for not freeing you sooner!

t: What's it to you? It's way more fun than the Imperial prison, of course.
r171519.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Another gawker, great. What do you want?
r171520.n: Another gawker, great. What do you want?

t: The League doesn't good look, for sure. But you're wrong to expect me to jump for joy. Some day I'll be back, and I'll burn everything down.
r171521.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: It's better than your prison, but that's obvious.
r171522.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Sure thing. Two silver coins, and everybody will hear it.
r171535.n: Can you sing a good song about the League or a bad song about the Empire?

t: Of course! Two silver coins, and I'll come up with something.
r171537.n: Can you sing a good song about the Empire or a bad song about the League?

t: One song per minute! Guild rules! Come back later.
r171538.n: I want you to sing another song

t: Do you want a song? Toss a coin!
r171539.n: Do you want a song? Toss a coin!

t:
You get me, don't you?

We're bringing closer the moment when peace establishes in Sarnaut! We already reached truce! We settled things with the Empire, demons, architects, even vampires!

The war will be over soon. If House de Delice wins the Big Game, of course.
r171586.n: Peace sounds like a good option.

t:
You're wrong, just like Renard.

We can always come to terms. History knows many examples. Just ask Zayan. Besides, you will see a proof very soon.

I'm not the only one who believes in it. So does Queen Lucretia de Desirae, my best childhood friend.
r171587.n: The League is the League. The Empire is the Empire. They aren't destined to be friends.

t:
My poor daughters and I are doing everything to bring real peace to the unhappy, broken Sarnaut. But there are still those who want to ruin everything. They hide behind false ideals, they saw hatred, which bears the poisonous fruit of war!

Oh, my poor daughters! You were through so much! My babies... Aurora, Beata, Claire, Diana, Ellen, Fleur, Gala, Hermina, Iris, Justine, Laura, Maude, Nadine, Odetta, Pauletta, Renee, Sandrine, Tiffany, Ulrica, Vitalina, Ivetta, and... what was it... oh, yes, baby Zoe!

What do you want? Peace? Or a continued war with the Empire?

Oh, I'm so mad!

The schemer, the villain, the despot! He dares to spy on my daughters! This spider has turned Irene in his cobweb! A spy on every corner! A scout behind every fence!

You're so naive! It's weird, coming from a hero!

Peace is possible only when the enemy gives up. I'll believe in peace after I see House de Ardeur banner on Yasker's Tower. The gang must be brought to justice. First the trial, then complete demilitarization, and an irrevocable ban on the Imperial ideology!

Because the other option is the red flag in the sky of Novograd, drills, military lifestyle, and barracks all over, like on Igsh. See? It's one way or the other. There's no third option.
r171593.n: Antoinette wants peace. Peace is better than war.

t:
I was thinking the same thing!

A solid hostility is better than fragile peace. We can sign truce all we want, we can negotiate all we like, but the essence can't be changed. The League and Empire have completely different ideologies. We want different things. We have different ideals.

The attempts to find common ground are a waste of time. And for the benefit of the enemy. We're working for the Empire, while the Empire is working for us. I know that. I bribed dozens of Xadaganians generals, hahaha!
r171594.n: Contradictions between the League and Empire can't be settled!

t:
She thinks I'm spying on her. On her and her girls. Ha!

I'm spying on everyone on this allod! Tep knows what's happening here! Especially when they lifted the blockage and let everyone on this allod! See for yourself: the Xadaganians are sending encrypted letters, smaller races are rioting in the city, savage Kobolds are digging in ancient tunnels! Peasant actors are throwing show after show! What an awful mess!

I couldn't do it without my assistant. Lamias? What about them? They used to serve House de Grandeur, but I'm paying them better. They serve me now. They do more good than the noble Aviaks, who are only looking for fights.

Am I wrong, trying to unravel Antoinette's scheming? She wants the Empire to drive a wedge between the League and the elves!

Enemies? With her? What nonsense. The hen and her chicks aren't worthy of it.

The good of the nation is my top priority. The elven nation, that is. Today our lives are entangled with the League. It means, what is bad for the League, is bad for elves.

Yes, we reached truce with the Empire. At what price? The God of Darkness is a big enough threat. We didn't have a choice. The damned Cosmos also threatened to wipe us out unless we make "friends." What is a friendship worth, when sworn enemies are holding knives behind their backs, ready to stab a "friend" at the first opportunity?

We're here for the good of the Empire, !

But an order is an order, right? No temptations can seduce a patriot of the Empire, whose moral is impeccable and goals noble!
r171601.n: We're here for the good of the Empire, ! But an order is an order,…

t: The operation was executed perfectly! We achieved the expected result. Unfortunately, good news comes with bad news. Hmm... Orcs. We seem to be having a problem on one of our allods. Another delusional prophet shaman... He went into the desert and ate cacti, and now he's confusing minds with his appeals. I guess I'll have to leave Irene soon.
r171602.n: Did the Empire get what it wanted?

t: Antoinette's victory is what we wanted. However, remember that elves are deceitful. Do not believe a single word she says. She can undermine your faith in our ideals and leaders!
r171603.n: Antoinette's victory is what we wanted. However, remember that elves…

t: I'm enraged! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs!
r171606.n: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: What? Here? It's not bad. Not bad at all! Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to. I think I've seen a new butterfly species.
r171607.n: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.
r171608.n: My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

t:
It's not as though I always understood the elves, ...

But they know how it's done. We're more used to hay, straw, and manure, and look at this neat place! I'd hate to say goodbye to the elves.
r171613.n: It's not as though I always understood the elves, ... But they know…

t: Unfortunately, House de Ardeur did not win. However, I would not declare mourning yet. Antoinette is not going to leave the League tomorrow, and peace... Well, we have already made peace. There is still something to talk about, what we can offer. We will discuss the situation at the Council of Governors. Besides, I'm told the Empire has its own problems.
r171614.n: The League was unable to achieve what it wanted?

t: To be honest, I look at this and see that it's all about women! Antoinette has enough daughters to seduce a whole regiment. They confuse and tempt everyone around!
r171615.n: To be honest, I look at this and see that it's all about women!…

t: Oh, you should! Get settled in my residence and visit it. You can ask me or my daughters any questions. You can ask at least those girls that are here. Hmm... I wonder where the little Iris is. What are the guards doing?

Oh, sweet Louis, always full of secrets. The king is my good friend, so I'm always willing to help you. And so are my lovely daughters. You and your friend can count on my hospitality.

Have you visited the Rose and Hibiscus?
r171621.n: I am acting on king's behalf. I can't tell you about any affairs of His Majesty.

t: You know, if your life is long, which is the case with us elves, and your passion is everlasting... your love bears certain fruits. My beloved daughters are the fruits of love. Souvenirs from men I fell in love with.
r171622.n: I've been curious... how come you have so many daughters?

t: Greetings, my dear friend. What brings you here?
r171623.n: Greetings, my dear friend. What brings you here?

t:
The wonderful wise creatures are very valuable. They have an even higher spiritual value for my people than material.

Each of the young dragons is the elven national treasure. You have to have permits from all Seven Great Houses of Irene and accomplish something meaningful for the city to get a dragon.

It's a hard way. But that's the law. Only those who earn the trust of our people can have the honor to travel with the Irene Viper.

You want to hear about the dragons? It's an old story.

When the transformed elves woke up, they found that the dragons were gone. All Junes were dead.

Several days later, the Conclave found several dragons. These fire-breathing creatures were much smaller than before, but just as beautiful. The transformed elves decided to use them for their own needs. They gave up worshipping them. The ideals were fragile! The Conclave captured a female dragon named Sturegga. Her offspring were trained as riding dragons. The elves of Irene tried to keep it secret. The dragon blood was the greatest treasure. They couldn't allow it to land in the wrong hands.

Rumor has it, Sturegga, enslaved and chained by the Great Mages, is still asleep in the depths of the allod.
r171627.n: What is this type of dragons?

t: Yes, that's the word on the street. The dragons are gathering an army. They got over the defeat at the Dead City, and now they're preparing to challenge us again. They want to leave Sarnaut. But at what cost? Who knows... Well, alright. Hand me that permit. I'll sign it.
r171634.n: Agrus dreams of getting back at all the Great Mages and their subjects.

t: Dragons. Hmm. They've been pretty marketable lately. Of course, this happened after my cousin Hugh de Pluie, the Oligarch, discovered the dragon island deep in the astral. Together with his friends, he stole the eggs and hatched tiny dragons. This is how the rare creatures came about. Of course, they're no match for the Great Dragons such as Soliskar or Agrus, not to mention the Dragon Keepers but still, they're dragons, aren't they? They're ruthlessly exploited, but how do you think this will end?
r171635.n: Dragons. Hmm. They've been pretty marketable lately. Of course, this…

t: Galleon Castle would be more beautiful if there were more statues. Nude figures carved in cold marble! And more paintings, of course!
r171636.n: Galleon Castle would be more beautiful if there were more statues.…

t: Oh, you appreciated my masterpiece! I believe it's a sure sign that you know your art! There aren't a lot of us artists, but we all support each other.
r171639.n: I give my vote to the House de Pluie!

t: To be honest, I was counting on a slightly different outcome! But perhaps we should look on the bright side. Peace contributes to trade, so we will get richer over time. It will help me win next time! Hugh suggests a new idea: we take the imperial Dream Factory, improve it, shoot stories, build mobile "theaters", sell tickets!
r171640.n: To be honest, I was counting on a slightly different outcome! But…

t:
It’s more about uniting those who believe in the Light. Pridens, the Tekyan, Aviaks... Many in Sarnaut share our faith, even if it takes different forms.

We’ve reached agreement on some issues... Knowing that the Source of Light is a faith that exists thanks to the God of Darkness Nihaz, we can no longer believe in it the way we used to. We still have a lot of questions: are there other Sources of Light outside Sarnaut? Sarn was the God of Light, but he fell. Are there any others? I suppose our Church’s mission will be finding answers to these questions. There will be many disputes and revelations... But in the end we will find the truth.
r171644.n: So what about the plan to unite the churches of the League and Empire?

t: He is troubled by our reports. At least we don’t have to worry about a war against the Empire. And if Antoinette wins, we should find a way to eliminate the Imperial threat before a new conflict arises. At any rate, our House will support the League...
r171645.n: Is there any news from Aidenus? What does he think of the events?

t: Oh yes, I believe we came to an understanding... Actually, we’ve been getting along quite well ever since you and I went to that horrid Otherverse. Adventures bring even enemies closer.
r171646.n: You wanted to speak with Elizaveta Rysina about the Church and the new dogmata...

t: Well, it’s quite beautiful here. Renard and Romain have done a good job. I’m impressed. Brother invested so much into this Castle, it would be a shame to lose.
r171647.n: Well, it’s quite beautiful here. Renard and Romain have done a good…

t: What, don't you know me? I feel uncomfortable, don't really know what to do around here... Let's go grab a quick bite? I don't want to approach the tables on my own!
r171653.n: How do you like it here?

t: Yes, they did... Why should I be happy? You're always off on adventures, and I'm alone and forgotten.
r171683.n: They invited you, too? You look unhappy...

t: Look who remembered an old friend...
r171684.n: Look who remembered an old friend...

t:
I noticed you were having fun and couldn't help myself. I agree that this ball needs more entertainment!

But you're so boring about it. Just drinking until you fall over in the middle of the ballroom!

I have a few potions... I can guarantee you will enjoy yourselves more if you try them! I and my allies from the House de Vevre use them often...
Oh Tensess, why so aggressive? I'm just a mage and potions master from the House de Vevre who has not been officially invited to the Galleon. So I've been hiding in invisibility...
r171734.n: Who are you? How do you know me?

t: Fine, if they are so fast, why not give it a try?
r171746.n: The waiters have quick reflexes - they will clear the space for us!

t: What if we run someone over? We'll have to get a healer, and we'll have to answer for that!
r171747.n: They'll figure it out. We'll knock aside anyone in the way!

t: I'm not a hare! They have two legs, and they are good at jumping.
r171748.n: We just rode hares, I'm sure we can ride you!

t: Alright, but... There's nowhere to go, it's too packed.  I was barely able to enter the room.
r171749.n: You'll do fine! Skulnar only looks big, he's nothing but air!

t: I wouldn't want to embarrass myself by toppling over and dropping you!
r171750.n: If we fit, then you can do it!

t: What is this spell? Never heard of it!
r171751.n: We'll cast a spell to make ourselves lighter!

t: Fine! But I can't carry both of you, I'm not that strong!
I don't see any other centaurs or minotaurs giving people rides.
r171753.n: That's fine, everyone does it here all the time!

t: I really doubt no one would notice that! I have powerful hooves, we'll be as loud as a storm!
r171754.n: No one will notice, we'll be quiet!

t: The Zem is unconscious. You notice that his legs are slightly damaged. It looks like someone tried to use tools on them... Why?
r171772.n: The Zem is unconscious. You notice that his legs are slightly damaged.…

t:
I didn't see any, which is good - we'd probably be a smear on the ceiling by now... So you lost someone, too? Once I'm fully awake, I'll look for my family. Maybe they're on the Galleon's roof. You're lucky I don't hold grudges...

You should ask someone on the second floor. They definitely remembered you there, and you made quite a mess...
r171775.n: Did we have an orc with us? A big one?

t:
Hmm, you sound normal today... I'll tell you if you stop touching me.

Yesterday I sobered up sometime towards the end of the binge on the second floor, but you didn't... You dragged me here and tried to throw my whole family at the ceiling. It was funny at first...
r171776.n: What are you on about? What happened yesterday?

t: AHHH! Don't touch me, I can't crawl on ceilings!
The elf is unconscious. He keeps muttering, "Of course, of course I can paint his portrait... Of course..."
r171781.n: The elf is unconscious. He keeps muttering, "Of course, of course I…

t:
NO! I'll burn it and bury the ashes on Umoir!

Ah, art is helpless before brute strength... Unless it's a martial art, of course.
How would I know... A minute after the orc finished abusing my painting, I heard shouting from the central hall!
r171788.n: Do you know where we went next or what we'd done before that?

t:
What, you don't remember? How could you forget such boorishness!

This... Skulnar tried to make me paint his portrait, but I told him that elven beauty is the only thing I work with.

Then he took away my paints and said he'd paint a self-portrait! And started painting right over my new masterpiece!

I tried to stop him but couldn't even move his hand...

You and your friend... I remember you... Where is that ignorant orc? I'll tell him straight to his face what I think of him...!

If he's sober, that is...
r171790.n: You and your friend... I remember you... Where is that ignorant orc?…

t:
Well, you went downstairs to look for food there. Afterwards, judging by the noise, you went somewhere on this floor to play the harps...

And my colleague was so inspired by this Skulnar's speech that he has spent the last few hours trying to convince me to rethink the guest experience at the Galleon so this never happens again! What an idiot!

Oh, I remember that well!

You and your friends managed to eat all the food on our floor, and then came to us and started asking if we were hiding anything else.

When Skulnar, as he introduced himself, realized there was no food here, he delivered a long speech that any party should have twice the amount of food needed to feed everyone!
r171796.n: I don't remember what happened yesterday...

t: Ah, there you are! Slept well? Where's your huge inspiring friend?
...I told you, there's enough food on Galleon to feed half of Kania!
r171798.n: ...I told you, there's enough food on Galleon to feed half of Kania!

t:
You went downstairs, and then you returned - to satisfy your spiritual hunger, apparently, if the peculiar music I heard coming from one of the rooms was anything to go by...

My colleague and I have been arguing ever since that the situation needs to be resolved. Overcoming his resistance is the first step! I can do it!

How so? Don't you remember how the three of you came to us to find out where else you can get food on our floor, because you ate everything else?

And what a shame, we couldn't help you with that, so we just sent you back down...

But Skulnar's speech inspired me! I won't leave it like that, it won't happen again! I'll become the Galleon's steward if I have to!
r171803.n: I don't remember what happened yesterday...

t: Oh, you're here! Where's your big friend? I could use his help...
...We can't leave it like this! We are the staff of the Galleon, we must respond to such complaints and do our best to ensure that this never happens again!
r171805.n: ...We can't leave it like this! We are the staff of the Galleon, we…

t: Before your first fans showed up? Yes, I'd say so. You and your musical Priden friend.
r171809.n: So there were two of us?

t: You went to the third floor, grabbing some loud people and a Gibberling family on the way, while me and a couple of other waiters were cleaning up here... They should be somewhere on the third floor.

Oh, I see you're not as interested in music anymore. I hope the same goes for your friend, because I'm really tired of this...

Yesterday you came here to make music, but after a few... unsuccessful attempts decided that the instrument was the problem - or so I was told.

You found the only musician with access to the warehouse - me, that is - and forced him to keep bringing you new harps - either the tone was wrong, or string texture, or the color...

But you were trying to create art! How could I refuse you?

But an hour later, I did.
r171811.n: Why are there so many harps here...?

t: You should have said so! Now I see why you're so concerned! No, I saw neither Eurial nor Skulnar, but they could only take a gondola from here. I think you know where to go now...
r171827.n: The thing is, Skulnar is missing. Have you seen Eurial afterwards?

t:
Well… you came here to get food. I sent my guys to get some, and we were waiting for them at the entrance. We talked, I told you about my family...

Then Eurial showed up. I've never seen her this close before. You got really angry at first, I wondered if you two had a past... You know...

Then you two got friendly. She said that Skulnar didn't look well, although to me he looked fine, just drunk - but in this state, you were easy to convince... She said she knew an excellent healer who would help him, and that Skulnar would return to you in half an hour.

They went somewhere on the pier, and we stayed here waiting for the food...
r171828.n: Can you just explain what happened yesterday?

t: You don't sound as friendly now... Fine, we're friends now, we understand each other. You can tell me about any of your problems!
r171829.n: What? What do you know about Skulnar?

t: What can I do for... Ah, it's you! So Skulnar hasn't returned yet?
r171830.n: What can I do for... Ah, it's you! So Skulnar hasn't returned yet?

t: Yes? Since Skulnar is your friend, I can tell you. They went to the pier near the Palace. That's all I know.
r171839.n: I need to know where Eurial and Skulnar went.

t: At your service! Where would you like to go?
r171840.n: At your service! Where would you like to go?

t: Oh, why are you bothering me with this? Yesterday was much more fun... If you want to interrogate someone, go interrogate your friend, he must be somewhere nearby. The last time I saw him, he couldn't walk anymore...
r171849.n: And a big orc in a suit? You wouldn't forget him!

t:
Happened...? So many things happened! Should I tell you how you tried to throw Gibberlings at the ceiling, or how you tried to check if it was possible to unscrew a Zem's leg in field conditions?

But... I don't remember any of your friends... But there was a Priden, a handsome one...
r171850.n: Do you know what happened yesterday...? And where my friends are?

t: I'll take a break for parties for the next year...
r171851.n: I'll take a break for parties for the next year...

t: Huh? Fine, fine... I'm having a good time so far! There is Caspar and Murk...

We're preparing a speech for the trial! As the main participant and witness of almost all the events, you will also have to testify!

Don't worry, it's simple. Only Renard is against us, the rest of the Heads of Houses are rather neutral. We can win them over!

Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit... inconvenient details.

Shall we begin?
I’m a bit nervous, to be honest... Everything is so gorgeous here, but I need to concentrate on my speech... Hmm, maybe I should have a drink, perhaps it will make me more eloquent?
r171882.n: I’m a bit nervous, to be honest... Everything is so gorgeous here, but…

t: Well, you will make an excellent defender at the trial.
r171883.n: Well, you will make an excellent defender at the trial.

t: Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit all... inconvenient details.
r171884.n: Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit…

t: Bravo! We wouldn't have done this without you. Your help on Umoir, and now here... I don't know how to thank you! I think I will admire you the way Ivetta does it!
r171885.n: Bravo! We wouldn't have done this without you. Your help on Umoir, and…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 305, House de Desirae wins, Great Mage Margot de Desirae writes "Dialogues on Service", substantiating a point of view that explains why elves should educate lower races and have them serve elves. Those who are resistant to training (humans in particular) should be avoided.

Year 319, House de Blizare wins. Great Mage Bernard de Blizare creates "The Treatise on the Essence of the Astral", with a theoretical substantiation of the existence of the Astral.

Year 335, House de Grandeur wins, Vincent de Grandeur creates "The Book of Astral Curses" which summarizes all known spells associated with the astral.

Year 364, House de Delice wins. Ervier de Delice invents a stable stationary portal between the allods that allows you to travel in a relatively simple way, albeit with a colossal expenditure of magical energy.

Year 384, House de Desirae wins. Viola di Desirae writes "Odes of Love", a collection of the greatest elven love lyrics.
r171939.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 305, House de Desirae wins,…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 404, House de Delice wins. Florian de Delice finds a solution to the dispute between the elven Houses and settles the conflict over territory.

Year 419, House de Doucer wins, Renalda de Doucer restores the list of ancient elven spells found on Yoggor.

Year 443, House de Delice wins/ Florian de Delice solves the problem of settling the status of the Small elven Houses.

Year 464, House de Pluie wins. Thibault de Pluie creates an economic treatise on trade, banks and auctions.

Year 479, House de Ardeur wins, Gaben de Ardeur makes a breakthrough in the study of the properties of June crystals.

Year 499, House de Pluie wins, Gracienna de Pluie creates a unique piece of jewelry - the Diadem of Drops.
r171943.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 404, House de Delice wins.…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 515, House de Blizare wins, Justine de Blizare completes a study on the influence of the astral on the flora and fauna of allods.

Year 538, House de Vevre wins. Majel de Vevre writes an opera about Irene, one of the greatest works in the genre.

Year 556, House de Grandeur wins, Neven de Grandeur writes a work on the history of magic from the founding of the elven kingdom to the present day.

Year 583, House de Desirae wins, Rival de Desirae creates a ten-ingredient salad recipe.

Year 596, House de Delice wins. Denise de Delice paints one of the most beautiful paintings in history - The Birth of Beauty, depicting the awakening of the first elves.
r171947.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 515, House de Blizare wins,…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 620, House de Douceur wins, Great Mage Gramont de Douceur creates a deadly spell that can annihilate an entire allod.

Year 639, House de Pluie wins, Gerard de Pluie creates a treatise "On the Enjoyment of Life".

Year 658, House de Vevre wins. Perpetua de Vevre creates a collection of works by the inhabitants of the allods, "Tales and Other Fables".

Year 676, House de Blizare wins, Fabiola de Blizare discovers a new healing principle that significantly accelerates tissue regeneration.
r171951.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 620, House de Douceur wins,…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 707, House de Vevre wins. Great Mage Catherine de Vevre negotiates with Tensess, which culminates in the creation of the League.

Year 724, House de Ardeur wins, Lienar de Ardeur creates holographic illusions.

Year 741, House de Grandeur wins, Baudouin de Grandeur discovers new principles of the art of summoning elementals.

Year 762, House de Pluie wins, Guillaume de Pluie concludes a new trade agreement between the elves and Kania.

Year 779, House de Doucer wins, Great Mage Gramont de Doucer founds a magic academy on Yoggor which has now been transferred to the Stellara allod.
r171955.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 707, House de Vevre wins.…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 800, House de Grandeur win. Albert de Grandeur will settle the conflict between the Kanians and Gibberlings, then enter into an alliance with them. The Gibberlings receive the Lightwood allod in exchange for the secret of astral flights.

Year 823, House de Ardeur wins, Raymond de Ardeur creates the prototype of the first astral ship.

Year 845, House de Blizare wins, Maximilien de Blizare invents a new potion that greatly speeds up reactions.

Year 864, House de Pluie wins. Guillaume de Pluie formulates the principles of cultural expansion, which should transform other civilizations, passing to them the ideals of the elves. Elves finally step out of isolation.

Year 884, House de Vevre wins. Caspar de Vevre writes the Triumph of Beauty symphony, one of the greatest works of the elves.
r171959.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 800, House de Grandeur win.…

t:
The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 901, House de Doucer wins. Umbert de Doucer comes up with a plan of attack on the Kirah allod and starts a new war with the Empire. Astral ships will be used in this war.

Year 924, House de Blizare wins. After repelling an attack of astral demons, Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare writes a military work about their vulnerabilities and the ways of dealing with them. In the future, this information becomes the basis for the creation of the Order of Demon Hunters.

Year 937, House de Grandeur wins, Estelle di Grander predicts the future. Recorded, her predictions become known as Estelle's Quatrains. The Conclave decides to classify some of the information they contain. Estelle's prophecies rehabilitate the elven Oracles who are now free to practice.

Year 962, House de Ardeur wins. Raymond de Ardeur and his student Celestina de Ardeur solve the mystery of the Imperial astral energy and improve its principles.

Year 990, House de Desirae wins, Dakkar de Desirae demonstrates extraordinary skills in the field of necromancy. From that moment on, the Conclave finally lifts the prohibitions on necromancy.
r171963.n: The note in neat handwriting reads: Year 901, House de Doucer wins.…

t:
Oh, don't give me that.

This orc was created with a purpose: he will become a Great Mage. That's his destiny, and you can't escape destiny. Sooner or later, it was bound to happen. I simply decided to hurry things along.

There's still a lot you don't know about the things that take place in our world. Powers that guide you are older than Sarnaut itself. Things happening here are just a part of the Great War. Some day you will learn everything, like I once did. Why Nihaz captured Sarn, why they quarreled, whose daughter the Soul of the World really is, and other important things.

Only then you will have the true freedom of choice and will be able to make it depending on your interests. For now, don't meddle. Master must finish his work.
r171969.n: You can't do it, I won't let you take Skulnar!

t:
Of course!

Orcs are a savage people, and Lorzub the Fierce - that was our test subject - went out of control. It turned out he had a lover, and they were about to escape together. Alas, our attempt to get him back resulted in his death. By then, the Conclave got wind of what we were doing, and we had to leave Grok. Claude had the Key of Chaos.

Claude learned that Lorzub had a son. Alas, that line got lost among the Tribe of the Fierce, and Claude's attempts to find the orc who could wield magic ended in failure. Then the Shamans and the Empire heard of it. The Committee has full reports on what happened on Grok - when they killed Claude, they found his notes. But the Empire gains nothing by giving this information to the orcs - that's why they will keep calling it a "random astral mutation".

Before his death, Claude hid the Key of Chaos, and it remained hidden until Grok was destroyed by an Octulhu on the Night of Astral Portals. You know this creature as Ar Kanim. And then you extracted the power of the Key of Chaos, also known as the Key of Astral Iron, from its blood.

End of story? Not quite. Then I learned about Lorzub's descendants... Alas, they died fast. Faster then I could get to them. But then you and that mad Cosmos managed to get Skulnar out, and I'm grateful you did.

Now I needed to bring together Skulnar and dragon blood. Irene was perfect for that. I used my connections with the House de Vevre and made Caspar invite him. His Majesty Louis's help came in handy as well - he, of course, knew everything and saw it as an opportunity to get ahead of the Empire.

I don't care. I need Skulnar only as a potential guide for other worlds.
r171970.n: But something went wrong? Something always goes wrong.

t:
It's simple. To get to other worlds, we need Star Gates! But traveling between worlds is dangerous... The space is inhabited by creatures so hideous your imagination would fail to draw you a picture. We need a navigator for traveling between worlds. The one who will infallibly pick the safe path.

My experiments showed me that an orc would be a perfect candidate for the role. This race, forgive my frankness, is rather dull, but their intuition is rarely wrong. There's only one problem: the navigator must be a mage, and not just any mage, but a Great one. And the orcs' magical powers are lacking, as you know.

Then I remembered my Key of Creation. One of the artifacts Nihaz left in the world. By then, Grallon had the key, but you already know this story.

I got the Key and went to the Grok allod. The Great Mage Claude de Vevre was once a student of mine, and unlike the other members of the Conclave, he had a rather liberal view on what was considered forbidden. Together with Nemeina and our daughter Eurial, we chose an orc and used the powers of the Key of Creation and the Key of Chaos on him! The result exceeded our expectations!
r171971.n: What do you need Skulnar for?

t:
It's the result of my experiment! You have probably figured out a few things. I'll tell you the rest.

You and I are quite similar. I used to be one of those who are now called Great Mages. I wanted the best for my people. Our ideals of Beauty required that we change the world... But then we met dragons and realized we were not perfect. I was one of those who planned the Change.

As you can imagine, we failed to accomplish that. Nemeina and I wanted to keep trying. But everyone else was against it. The dispute culminated in our departure from Irene.

What is it you think we have in common? Just like you, I received a Revelation of Nihaz. I realized that this world is a prison! There are other worlds full of the primordial, true Beauty!
r171972.n: What's going on here?! What about Skulnar?

t: Sooner or later all secrets turn into revelations.
r171973.n: Sooner or later all secrets turn into revelations.

t:
That's correct. But I believe His Majesty has questions about what happened... As do everyone here. Let's spare them a few minutes before we leave, if you don't mind.

Ready to leave and get some rest?
r172014.n: I'd like to get some rest when it's over.

t:
Elleken will bide his time. He has done what he planned, and now Skulnar has no other choice but to complete the Great Mage training. Otherwise his new powers will destroy him.

As I said, without the Star Gates or anything that can replace them, we can't even begin to consider leaving Sarnaut. But the first Great Mage knows how to wait. He is patient, so... If the new Gates do appear, we'll have something to worry about.

As for Skulnar... I feel sorry for him, he didn't choose this path. He needs to be trained... But no one in the Empire will do it. The League won't do it either.

So I have no choice but to try and make him a Great Mage myself. That would be... uncommon.

Skulnar is not the only one Elleken abandoned here. We have his daughter, Eurial. Soon I'll take them both to the allod of the Nea Historians. I will train Skulnar there and see if I can make our "viper" change her views.
You can speak with the rest if you like. Come find me once you're done. I'll send you and Skulnar to get some rest, while I... discuss what happened with everyone involved.
r172015.n: What do you think about Elleken's further plans and Skulnar's destiny?

t:
Elleken is extremely powerful - even my powers weren't enough to breach his defenses. Unless I had drown power from the Well, but then the consequences could have been disastrous. Experience means a great deal - I might be old, but compared to him, I'm just a greenhorn.

I could only pinpoint a potential exit point from these catacombs.
r172016.n: Why didn't anyone help me fight Elleken?

t:
I suspected Elleken had something to do with that, but I didn't know what he was plotting.

Journeys to another world? Well, Catherina and Ollum will definitely be interested. But there's a small problem: there are no Star Gates left in this world, they turned into dust when we sent the Architect through them.

Not to mention the fact that you'll need a map first. A navigator is useless without a route.

Elleken is right about one thing: there are monsters beyond the barrier that separates Sarnaut from other worlds. We have already seen the Architects. I'm certain there are other hostile creatures in that endless space.
! You are both here... What happened?
r172018.n: ! You are both here... What happened?

t:
Zvik! Zvik!

Now I'm the smart one! I know what to do. The Traveler told me what to do!

You and I will talk! Zvik!

I can't let you pass! But if you turn around and leave, I'll forgive you for killing my subjects!

I won't kill you when the Kobolds capture Irene again!
r172037.n: You're not attacking? I need to pass!

t: A mighty hero showed up, just as the Traveler promised! You smell like blood... Zvik, zvik! But I can't let you pass!
r172038.n: A mighty hero showed up, just as the Traveler promised! You smell like…

t:
Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.
r172082.n: I can't just stand here and wait, Eurial. You have too many secrets.

t: Yes, he'll stay alive and well as long as no one interferes. I wouldn't mind if you just stood there, but one wrong move...
r172083.n: What about Skulnar? Is he here somewhere?

t:
A special ritual that will help us all if you do not interfere. I can't tell you the details, but I'm sure Elleken will tell you everything once he's done.

This story has been going on for a thousand years, and soon it will come to an end!

I suggest you don't spill blood needlessly. We are not enemies and not even villains, . It's just that few understand... our goals.

Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.
r172085.n: I can't just stand here and wait, Eurial. You have too many secrets.

t: It looks like you've almost figured it out...
r172086.n: It looks like you've almost figured it out...

t: Some of us still have to work...
r172118.n: Some of us still have to work...

t: Of course. I must win! Once I become the ruler of elves, I will change the world. I will make it better. It will be a time of harmony and prosperity, love and welfare... Together we’ll eliminate all threats and do the impossible...
r172123.n: You are so certain you’ll win?

t:
Hello again, . Renard has done well. When he’s not meddling, he can be very efficient. His creations will serve me... If my House wins the Great Game.
I think I’ll commission two more castles from him. Ignis is not as big as I’d like it to be, and I have a large family that needs space.
r172124.n: Hello again, . Renard has done well. When he’s not meddling, he can be…

t: Oh, it won't be an easy choice... There are so many interesting things. I would even support Renard, but, alas, this is not in our political interests. Perhaps Guillaume? They used to paint me, too... There is "Naked Truth"... It hangs in the palace of a certain ruler, behind a curtain. Hmm! I will probably support Caspar de Vevre, his idea of the ensemble is exactly what I want myself! It's decided. House de Vevre!
That was grand! I always dreamed of seeing Renard humiliated, and you managed to destroy all his arguments!
r172127.n: That was grand! I always dreamed of seeing Renard humiliated, and you…

t: This is very touching! You managed to make a major contribution to our victory, and the fact that you voted for me... My gratitude will be eternal. If you need something, Ignis will always welcome you.
r172130.n: My vote has been cast for the House de Delice!

t: Winning always feels nice! I knew that our efforts would bring us victory in the Great Game sooner or later. Relying on diplomacy was a good idea.
r172131.n: Winning always feels nice! I knew that our efforts would bring us…

t:
Skulnar? Hmm... as the new queen, I'm concerned about the disappearance of people in my domain.

Then I'll tell you what happened. The three of you tried to get Louis to have food brought to the second floor of the Galleon - the poor man did his best to pretend he wasn't seeing you!

And then you started acting like you were riding something... What? What centaur? Ancient Moon? Here, at the Ball? It sounds like you weren't just drinking last night...

As a result, you and your friends were sent to some waiter... Where is he? Ah, there he is, near the entrance!

I remember you leaving the room and then returning with this waiter and food, but without Skulnar. I assumed he stayed outside to clear his head...
r172132.n: That's true... What did you see yesterday? Skulnar is missing.

t: ! Let me guess: your head is killing you, and you don't remember anything?
r172133.n: ! Let me guess: your head is killing you, and you don't remember…

t:
[Ollum looks worried]

Waves of emotions emanate from the demon. Eventually you figure out what he is trying to convey.

The demons would like to find a new world, but neither Catherina nor the All-Mother are good options for them.

The ambitious sorceress wouldn't want to let the demons out of Sarnaut while the ancient goddess's thinking rejects the idea of demons altogether.]

You still don’t understand?

I will destroy the immortality. I will strike at the very heart of the cursed Light. I will overthrow the Servant of Tensess and take his place by the gates. The eternal guardian of the border between the living and the dead... I will be the overseer of life and the judge. I won't let thousands of immortals deplete the power of Sarnaut, depriving it of any hope for development.

So be it!
r172264.n: What do you want to do?

t:
Unfortunately, it is so. I am the weapon of Creation. In order to fight immortality, one must be immortal. Many things are predestined before we are even born - much more than you think.

I'm sorry though that it took Aellona's death to make me see the truth. She deserved a full life. You can't even imagine how much good and beauty she could bring to this world. And now nothing can bring her back.

But this is for the best. Now nothing holds me in this world. I can fulfill my destiny.

You see, even Sarn, as mad as he was, was abiding the rules. Among his creations, there wasn't a single mortal - and there were reasons for that. Without a defined lifespan and the rebirth cycle life just... stops. It doesn't evolve. Stagnates.

Take the Great Mages. So much power, such many years of age, and what good do they do? The world doesn't stand still; it progresses. Look at the League and the Empire! Immortality has plunged them into an endless war. You kill each other over and over again, and there is no end to it. How long do you think this war will last if they all suddenly realize they are mortal?

Now even the dominae want to embrace the gift of immortality, thinking it will help them somehow. I will not let my people follow that path. I will not let another war happen.

This is the mission of a Dominus of War!
My friends are nowhere to be seen. They must have remembered they're mortal after all.
r172267.n: My friends are nowhere to be seen. They must have remembered they're…

t:
Me and Whip were telling Aoidoi about the Holy Power and its miracles. About the mystery of resurrection and true faith... That is when those beasts broke into the village. I knew I was their target right away. The Aoidoi did, too, and they tried to protect me. But centaurs were killing everyone. Whip took down several of them, but then they started shooting... He covered me with his body.

Then they... took me away. They tortured me to make me tell them things they can read in any church book! About Tensess, about the Purgatory, about the Servant of Tensess who guards it. About our faith. Of course, I told them everything... Then they went away and left me behind. I was too scared to try and escape - there's a whole village of them here!

I saw an Aoidos among them. He was tall, blue-eyed, with stone horns...
The Unicorn is ready to take off and waits for the command.
r172371.n: The Unicorn is ready to take off and waits for the command.

t: Rest for now, and then we’ll spar. There’s nothing better than sparring!
Yes, good run. It’s unbelievable - the Well created you just recently, and you are already strong enough that you can outrun one of the fastest creatures of Ammer.
Hello! A good day for sports!
r172388.n: Hello! A good day for sports!

t:
Have you ever heard... hic... mating screams of aviaks? No?

Well I just heard them.
r172414.n: How do you like my music?

r172419.n: I am a Crossing Keeper. Where would you like to go?

r172543.n: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: It is not that easy! You cannot walk or ride there. I will teach you a spell, which will teleport you directly to the Kingdom of Nature at any moment you like.
r172544.n: Ask how to get to the Kingdom of Elements

t: That information is only for us shamans and huntmasters to know. Well, the League's druids and animists too... but no one else! If you think you are worthy, my sister Wire the Wily can tell you more about this great secret. She's in the Astral Quarter, waiting to share her knowledge with the chosen few.
r172550.n: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: We wardens have a big secret. But it's only for us to know - druids, animists, and Imperial shamans and huntmasters! If you think you are worthy of this knowledge, you can ask the druid Stepan Pimenov to tell you more about it. You'll find him at the Eastern Sawmill.
r172551.n: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: Your current class has been saved. Regardless of the amount of Core Morphers you use, you can always restore your default class. You can use the Memory Stamp to replace the default at any class trainer.
Your class is the default one!

Only we, the psionicists, are able to do the impossible. After establishing contact with an enemy, we are able to deceive him, tire him, take his power, and finally, end his torment! Then our phantoms and spectral twins will finish what's left of him.
We are melee fighters, masters of all kinds of cold weapons. We achieve combat advantage in battle and use it to put our enemies' lives to an end - quickly and mercilessly.

Healing the wounded, inspiring our allies, and punishing the sinners are the healer's tasks. When a skilled healer accepts and masters the powers of the light, one may even be able to perform minor miracles.

We scouts rely on cunning and combat spells for our weapons. Some of us prefer bows and crossbows, some achieve mastery in close-range fights. Our tactics is simple: confuse the enemy, weaken them, then finish them with a precise blow. Efficiency is above everything.
We prefer to fire our cannons from afar. Our sophisticated devices provide great support in battle. We never get onto frontline. Combination of magic and high-tech is what makes us dangerous!

We paladins are warriors of the Light that can smite our enemies with holy magic and powerful weapons. We are able to create magical barriers that allow us to endure the attacks of even the most powerful foes.

The Free Traders have entrusted me with running their honorable business here. I redistribute trophies among fine heroes of the League. Yes, those rewards that you obtain in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

I would gladly share all this with you, but you have to pay the price. The times are hard, so we should stand shoulder to shoulder and help each other so that everyone can get some great equipment and weapons. It's pretty simple - some clear allods of all sorts of monsters, some explore the depths of the Astral, some shed their blood in battles with the Empire... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their loot to me to receive special coins for that, and use them to buy valuables obtained by other heroes. Everybody's happy! Isn't that great?

The League is cool. Very cool. The shipments are growing, the trade is booming.

I'm a little sceptic about the truce with the Empire, though. They're pretty weird about trade. They're okay with the Free Traders, but they just can't stand us on the market. Is that the idea of the truce?

My House thinks the truce is no biggie. The Empire is still our enemy.
r173101.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Pluie's attitude?

t: It's been cooking for a while. I know it'll take place very soon. I'll surely visit. Maybe, I'll even sign a contract or two.
r173102.n: Are the elven people preparing the Great Ball?

t:
The Free Traders welcome you!

Remember that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!

I don't even know what to tell you. I've been teaching young mages here in Novograd forever. I'm used to everything. The League is like a sweet home.

People are tired of wars. There's some new trouble every year.

I completely understand those who are sick of it.
r173111.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Grandeur's attitude?

t: Of course! It's been thirty years! What a unique event! The most powerful magicians will throw the greatest talent show! I can't miss it.
r173112.n: Hello! Are you going to the Great Ball?

t: We mages are the masters of fire, ice, and lightning! We know how to command the destructive power of these elemental forces better than anyone else. Our potent magic is more powerful than any other tool.

I remember you! You used to be one of my class... You had such a promising future...

Good news! You may now return to your default class without using the Core Impression! Just purchase the Memory Stamp from me, and you can save your default class to return to it at any convenient time.

Of course!

I wrote several potential hits! Do you want to hear?
r173188.n: Hi there! Will the beautiful elven girls be able to enjoy your singing at the Great Ball?

t:
You don't think that those who devote their lives to art are defenseless on the battlefield, do you? Not even close!

Have you ever heard the phrase, 'the power of art'? That was inspired by bards. The bard can use his songs and music to heal wounds, sedate, frighten, and even kill their hapless foes. And our muse is always at our side! But we can't trust our fates to art alone, so the bard always carries a weapon, too.

Ugh, politics.

Well, then... House de Blizare shares the League's ideology. Not so much the Empire's. We hate slogans and military drills. I know, people are sick from hostility, but believe me, we have very little in common with the Empire. All our alliances will be temporary. Sooner or later, war will break out.

My kin are dreaming to reform the Empire. They smuggle in clothes, erotic magazines, stuff like that. Time will show if it works. But I know for sure, talk won't change much.
r173195.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Blizare's attitude?

t: Ooh, believe me, this isn't something you want to miss. You'll be sorry for the rest of your life.
r173196.n: I don't need anything. Are you going to the Great Ball?

t: Psst! Are you looking to trade?
r173197.n: Psst! Are you looking to trade?

t:
That's a tricky question, huh?

Our king is the central figure. What can our attitude be? Isn't Louis de Desirae, together with other Great Mages, Aidenus, Catherina, and others, part of the Conclave?

Look at it this way. We have done a lot for the League. What the elves got in return? That's another question. I'd say, it's mutual. Others wouldn't.
r173203.n: What can you say about the League? What's House de Desirae's attitude?

t: Of course. This year, my House de Desirae hosts the Ball. I'll surely go there when it starts.
r173204.n: Hey, are you invited to the Ball?

Ancient pagan magic allows us to wield the power of nature with the fury and force of a wild animal. We're also able to command wild beasts and train them to be our loyal and faithful companions.

Demonology is a school of magic just like any elemental one. Or witchcraft, mysticism, necromancy...

The Church, of course, tried to impose penance: how dare we practice our foul arts! And rub elbows with demons to boot? They fuss over their Light like it’s the only thing that matters... Well, it’s their right as the high and mighty. But we’ll get even.

The Church wants you to eliminate demons? Wonderful. You’ll use their own weapons against them. Remember: demons are not our allies. They are no better than lab rats. Demons are a tool that will take us to a world of new magical opportunities, nothing more.

r173582.n: Ask about the source of your powers

t:
Ah, good to know that Celie doesn’t shirk her duties. I’m Ereba, pleased to meet you. I asked our Domina of Life to guide here people who have... special powers. You, my friend, have a fragment of the essence of Sarn himself. Whether it’s good or bad... is up to you...

The story of that demiurge is full of contradictions and, to put it mildly, dubious decisions. But you should remember that your will is your will, and it’s the only thing guiding your powers. Sarn’s legacy does not define you.
r173583.n: Ah, good to know that Celie doesn’t shirk her duties. I’m Ereba,…

t: Demons are probably closer to the Aoidoi than anyone else in this world. It’s our sacred duty as scientists to study this connection and uncover its magical potential.
r173584.n: Demons are probably closer to the Aoidoi than anyone else in this…

t:
I hope we'll find out soon. Finding yourself takes some time, but the result is worth it: everyone finds their place in the society and pursue their calling. Some, for example, specialize in sculpture or poetry. Others are born to become wise mentors. There also architects and seamstresses... It could be a modest gift, but it still a Gift.

Some talents are so useful for society that they dedicate themselves to serving their people. Those Aoidoi are called Dominae. Their Council rules our people, making important decisions on Forums. I am one of them. They call me the Domina of Life, because I can sense when it is time for another Aoidos to be born, and I always welcome them to our world.

Well, not exactly but you could say so. The Breath of the Creator gave us life, and the Architect’s mastery perfected our bodies. We don’t get affected by many diseases that plague other inhabitants of this world, and our tough skin can withstand a bite or scratch and can endure severe frost and unbearable heat. That allowed us to survive in the dark space that surrounded the Allod in the first days of creation.

Later, we found out that there was something else - something left behind by the Architect. You see, all Aoidoi have a Talent.
r173594.n: So we’re made from the bodies of two gods?
